principle: Only odds/probabilities stored with the pre-race PT3 prediction are used to size stakes. Official payouts are used only for settlement.

strategies.fixed_2000: Keep every PT3 pick at >=100 yen and allocate the rest to equalize projected gross return.
strategies.no_torigami_2000: Spend 2,000 yen only on a probability-maximizing subset of PT3 picks whose send-time projected gross return can each reach >=2,000 yen.
